prompt:
A desktop web app screen for Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent, Hive, works on its own computer. Edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window or device. Three reference images: the first is Hive's real current app (keep its flat dark graphite look, teal accent, rounded controls, bee mascot, icon rail with labels and channel list; do not copy its content); the second is Meta AI's chat on a phone and the third is OpenAI Dots' desktop app: they are references for how the chat itself behaves only, never content or branding.
Shell as the first reference: icon rail (Chat, Activity, Goals, Apps, Calendar, Files, Computer), the channel list with 'launch', 'design', 'ops' ('ops' active), the header '# ops' with 'Computer · online'. Conversation, plain and regular: Marcus (person, 10:41): '@hive compare the two carriers using shipping-rates.csv. How much do we save?' as a soft right-aligned bubble. Then Hive's reply, left, with the small bee avatar above it: 'The second carrier is cheaper in every zone, 11.9% less overall, $11.40 saved on one parcel of each kind.' followed by two short bullets ('Zone 1 and 2 save about $1.20 each', 'Delivery times are not in the rate card, so a two-week trial is wise'). Under it a file chip with a paperclip: 'carrier-comparison.html'. Then Priya (10:44): 'Great, can you draft the note to Marcus?' and Hive's one-line reply 'On it.' with a dim line 'Worked for 3 minutes ▸'. A rounded composer at the bottom: a + button, 'Message #ops', a small 'Thinking' pill, a send arrow.
Layout: Meta chat, plain agent text, with the file result opened beside it. Tapping the 'carrier-comparison.html' chip opened a flat result panel docked on the right with a title 'Carrier comparison', a close X, a clean table (zone, current, second carrier, saving) and small back and forward arrows at the bottom. Flat dark graphite, teal accent.
